# Story 2: Product Search

> **Status:** Not Started
> **Priority:** Medium
> **Dependencies:** None

## User Story

**As a** shopper
**I want** to search the catalog by keyword
**So that** I can find a product without browsing every category

## Acceptance Criteria

> **AC IDs assigned through:** AC-2.3

- [ ] Given a keyword that matches products, when the shopper submits the search, then matching products are listed with name, price, and thumbnail `[AC-2.1]`
- [ ] Given more than 20 matches, when results are shown, then 20 appear per page with numbered page links `[AC-2.2]`
- [ ] Given a keyword with leading or trailing spaces, when the search runs, then the spaces are trimmed before matching `[AC-2.3]`

## Implementation Tasks

- [ ] 2.1 Write tests for every acceptance criterion
- [ ] 2.2 Implement the behavior
- [ ] 2.3 Verify all acceptance criteria are met

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All tasks completed
- [ ] All acceptance criteria met
- [ ] Tests passing
